chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال اللّٰه تعالى:
﴿إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ يُخَادِعُونَ اللّٰهَ وَهُوَ خَادِعُهُمْ وَإِذَا قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَامُوا كُسَالَى يُرَاءُونَ النَّاسَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللّٰهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ [سورة النساء: ١٤٢].
وقال تعالى:
﴿مُذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَا إِلَى هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَلَا إِلَى هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ سَبِيلًا﴾ [سورة النساء: ١٤٣].
أي مترددين، لا إلى المسلمين، ولا إلى الكافرين.

Allah, the Exalted, says:
“Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is fully aware of what they do. And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and guard their private parts, and not reveal their adornment except what ordinarily appears thereof, and to draw their head-coverings over their chests, and not reveal their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their women, those whom their right hands possess, male attendants having no sexual desire, or children who are not yet aware of women’s private aspects. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, so that you may succeed.”
 [Sūrat al-Nūr 24:30–31]

Allah, the Exalted, says:
“O you who believe, do not enter houses other than your own until you seek permission and greet their occupants. That is better for you, so that you may take heed. If you find no one therein, do not enter until permission is given to you. And if you are told, ‘Go back,’ then go back; that is purer for you. And Allah knows well what you do. There is no blame upon you for entering uninhabited houses in which there is some benefit for you. And Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal.”
 [Sūrat al-Nūr 24:27–29]

وقال تعالى: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَنْ يَرْتَدَّ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِي اللّٰهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ يُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ [سورة المائدة: ٥٤].

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال اللّٰه تعالى:
﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ﴾ [سورة المائدة: ١٠١].
وقال تعالى:
﴿يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللّٰهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ﴾ [النساء: ١٧١].

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah, the Exalted, says:
“O you who believe, do not ask about matters which, if made known to you, would distress you.”
 [Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:101]
And He, the Exalted, says:
“O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about Allah except the truth.”
 [Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:171]
